newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE FLOAT VALUED AT $307 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE FLOAT VALUED AT $307 MILLION.

text.p: English premier league club Newcastle said on Friday that their stock market flotation valued the club at 193 million pounds ($307.4 million).
The offering of 40 million shares was priced at 135 pence (215 cents) per share and would raise 54 million pounds for the club, a statement from Newcastles's investment bank NatWest Markets said.
Dealing in the shares will begin on April 2.
